original_test_intent: Run the approved AMD System Stress Tester CPU/FPU and85%-memory profile for8 hours while measuring CPU/memory power and die temperature, then verify stable error-free system health.
original_method: Record platform/tool identity and baseline health; validate licensed AMDSST/AVT versions, paths and options; approve8h/85% profile and thresholds; run tracked stress with non-lossy telemetry and hard abort; preserve all logs; stop processes, restore approved state and obtain engineer verdict.
manual_activity: User supplies licensed AMDSST/AVT and approves workload/limits; qualified operator confirms cooling/power readiness; agent may execute tracked run afterward.
required_inputs: Licensed AMDSST and AVT versions/checksums/docs/install paths
Validated exact AMDSST option syntax, modules, FPU,85% memory and8-hour profile
Correct AVT path and noninteractive PMM/die-temperature telemetry method/cadence
CPU/memory identity, cooling/power headroom, node isolation and log storage
Power/temperature/ECC/OOM/watchdog/system-log abort, cleanup, recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Require explicit owner approval for8h and85% memory load
Validate tool options and telemetry before stress
Track PIDs/session and hard timeout; preserve full output
Abort on telemetry loss, thermal/power limit, ECC/OOM/watchdog/hardware error or instability
No automatic rerun, reboot or silent profile/power/governor change
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied packages/profile and baseline health
Run exact approved tracked AMDSST and collect non-lossy AVT/system telemetry
Terminate all processes, restore approved state and preserve diagnostics
Do not guess path/options, downgrade to help probe, alter profile, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve AVT path and validate version-specific commands
Review complete evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not test execution: `--help` neither loads CPU/memory nor collects AVT; unsafe SSH, nested quoting and truncation are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use supplied version's validated equivalent of the exact8h AMDSST profile with tracked PID/hard timeout and logged AVT PMM/thermal polling.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 8h, modules, memory enabled/85%, FPU enabled, AVT power/temperature,30/500 fields and error-free/workable criterion are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a version-pinned stress/telemetry manifest with live abort controller and complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package provenance, validated path/options, tracked processes, non-lossy telemetry, thresholds and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A help probe or short generic stress has no CPU/FPU/memory endurance coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: 85% memory and sustained CPU load can trigger OOM, thermal throttling, power caps or service interruption.

project_override_considerations: Duration/load changes require explicit project approval and must be reported as changed coverage; AMDSST licensing and AVT compatibility cannot be inferred.
expected_evidence: Exact approved command/profile and tracked start/end/duration/status
Complete AMDSST output and module/FPU/memory results
Timestamped CPU/memory power and die temperature without watch loss
Abort/cleanup/restoration, final health and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Restores the actual licensed8-hour workload and AVT evidence while preventing a help probe or path typo from being counted as stress coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A help command proves only binary presence. The source requires simultaneous CPU/FPU and high-memory load plus power/thermal evidence over8 hours; monitoring must survive the session and correlate with stress timestamps. A relative AVT path may execute the wrong location or fail silently, so version/path validation is part of test validity.
